note.en: A tiny glassy eulimid snail, a parasite of echinoderms, known here from one INBio specimen at 9 m on the west side of Punta Mona island.
note.es: Un caracol eulímido diminuto y vítreo, parásito de equinodermos, conocido aquí por un espécimen del INBio a 9 m en el lado oeste de la isla de Punta Mona.

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records for the region box (INBio Atta collection, iNaturalist)

marks.en: Smooth, glassy, slender white shell with a pointed spire.
marks.es: Concha lisa, vítrea, esbelta y blanca con espira puntiaguda.
